# ryczalt-cli

> A command-line tool for the bookkeeping of a sole proprietorship on ryczałt. It reads an invoice archive (one YYYY-MM folder per month) and shows, month by month, the revenue, the ryczałt, the ZUS contributions and the payment deadlines, and at the end of the year the figures for PIT-28 and for the annual health contribution settlement.

The program is written in Go and uses only the standard library. It records payments, prepares the next invoice as an Invoify file, submits it to KSeF through ksef-cli, keeps the revenue register (table, CSV, JPK_EWP) and handles a suspended business. It handles one setup: ryczałt, VAT-exempt under art. 113 and monthly payments. The same site exists in Polish at https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/.

## Pages

- [Introduction](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/): what the tool does, features, installation, the first commands and the monthly routine
- [Configuration](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/configuration/): the ryczalt.conf file, the lookup order, the tax, zus, client, ksef, r2 and jpk sections and the accepted values
- [Invoice archive](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/archive/): the YYYY-MM folder layout, the files the program reads and writes, and what it never overwrites
- [Commands](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/commands/): every command with its options, sample output and exit codes
- [Year-end](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/year/): PIT-28 figures, the revenue register and JPK_EWP, the annual health contribution settlement, DRA block XII and a suspended business
- [How it calculates](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/rules/): the revenue date and the NBP rate, cumulative ryczałt, ZUS phases, health brackets, deadlines and holiday calendars, with sources
- [About](https://ryczalt.piotrkrzysztof.dev/en/about/): what the tool does not do, code layout, tests, license and author
